negative: One deliberately wrong expected bit is detected; the same image otherwise completes the full campaign.
coverage: 512 words, 32 payload bits, zero/ones/address patterns and walking one/zero patterns; aligned MCU word loads and stores.
boundary: Repeated runs on one device qualify this exact vendor image. They do not qualify a newly emitted open image, timing, independent clocks, byte masks, dual-port collisions or other sites. Raw vendor material remains outside this repository.
